title: Delta Rollout Cookbook and Telemetry Handoff (Q2 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact operations cookbook for the "delta" rollout family (small-scope model routing + autoscaling change). Primary goal: safe, observable ramp and an actionable telemetry handoff so SRE/ops can take over after T+4h. This doc is intentionally pragmatic — call-outs, quick commands, and rollback triggers first.

Scope (what's in/out):
- In scope: model routing config change (route to v2), autoscaler parameter tweak (scaleDown grace from 60s -> 120s), observability tweaks (add kvcache miss rate chart).
- Out of scope: client API contract changes, large dataset migrations, infra reimages.

High-level calendar (times are PDT):
- T-72h (2026-04-05): Finalize PR + run small synthetic load locally (done).
- T-24h (2026-04-07): Preflight smoke + rollout dry-run in staging (ops checklist validated).
- T-2h  (2026-04-10 08:00): Staffing confirmation, pager rotation, Slack watch channel open (#releases-delta).
- T0    (2026-04-10 10:00): Start canary — 1% traffic for 15m.
- T0+15m: Evaluate metrics. If green, T0+15m escalate to 5% for 30m.
- T0+45m: 20% for 60m.
- T0+105m: 50% for 60m.
- T0+165m: 100% cutover and monitor for 4h. After T+4h, formal handoff to SRE.

Staffing & Roles (shift plan):
- Release Lead: Aisha Patel (on-call for escalation).
- Observability Lead: Marco Chen (owns dashboards/queries).
- Rollback Captain: Evelyn Ruiz (executes rollback and communicates to PM/customer-success).
- Night ops triage: Jonah Kim (T+2h onwards).
- Backup contact: SRE rotation group (pager: PGR-RELEASES primary).

Preflight checklist (quick commands and asserts):
- Code & infra:
  - PR merged and deployed to rollout branch: `git log -n1 --oneline` -> verify PR #1123.
  - Deployment artifact present in registry: `gcr.io/redwood-inference/release/delta:v2` exists.
  - Infra templates validated: `terraform plan` shows no drift.
- Staging tests:
  - Run smoke: `./scripts/smoke-run.sh --env=staging` -> 0 failures.
  - Bump canary in staging using `kctl set` and confirm traffic split.
- Observability:
  - Dashboards populated: model-latency, kvcache-miss, token-cost, error-rate.
  - Alerts: error-rate > 0.5% / p95-latency > SLA (250ms) firing rules present.
- Communication:
  - Slack channel created: `#releases-delta` and pinned runbook.
  - Pager schedule posted and acknowledged by all on-call.

Canary ramp decision table (quick read):
- Pass criteria for each step (must be met to proceed):
  - No increase in 5xx rate by > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive windows (1m windows).
  - p95 latency increase < 1.25x baseline.
  - KV cache miss rate <= baseline + 3 percentage points.
  - Cost per token change within expected bound (+/- 8%).
- Fail criteria (immediate rollback):
  - 5xx rate spike > 5x baseline OR sustained p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m.
  - Any client errors affecting authentication or data corruption.
- If unknown: pause at the current percentage and escalate to Observability Lead.

Telemetry handoff (what to send to SRE at T+4h):
- Data package (link + one-line):
  - Dashboard snapshot link: `grafana/redwood/dashboards/delta-rollout?snapshot=...`
  - Query list (copy/paste):
    - Total requests by model variant: `sum(rate(requests_total{route=~"delta.*"}[1m])) by (variant)`
    - 5xx rate: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[1m]))`
    - KV cache miss rate: `sum(rate(kvcache_miss_total[1m])) / sum(rate(kvcache_requests_total[1m]))`
    - BOS (burst-ops) throttles: `increase(throttle_events[5m])`
  - Alert list and mute state: include screenshot/link to alert manager with mute settings.
- Recommended alert thresholds (for SRE to adopt immediately):
  - `high-error` -> 5xx > 1% for 5m.
  - `latency-surge` -> p95 > 400ms for 10m.
  - `kvcache-deterioration` -> delta(miss_rate, baseline) > 4% for 10m.

Rollback plan (fast path):
- Who: Rollback Captain (Evelyn) authorized.
- How: Revert the routing change in the traffic router and scale down v2 via deployment api: `curl -XPOST $ROUTER/api/traffic -d '{"split": {"v2":0}}'` then `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving -n production --to-revision=REV_BEFORE`.
- Communication: Immediately post in #releases-delta with summary + JIRA ticket created `REL-2346` and call the on-call SRE.
- Post-rollback checklist: run smoke again, mark incident + short RCA placeholder.

Release notes (draft for customer-facing changelog):
- Summary: "Improved routing to the v2 model for select customers; safer autoscaler behavior to reduce churn during short spikes."
- Customer impact: "Expected: none. Observed improvements: small reduction in p95 latency for inference-heavy routes. If you see 5xx errors, open a support ticket and include request-id and timestamp."
- Technical details: "Route change applied to runtime router; autoscaler scaleDown grace increased to 120s. No model API changes."
- Known issues: "Edge case: transient cold-start latencies for customers hitting previously-idle capacity (investigating pre-warm)."

Post-release actions (T+4h -> T+72h):
- T+4h: Handoff to SRE with telemetry package and companion runbook link.
- T+24h: Quick sync — confirm no regression signals; status note in release tracker.
- T+72h: Close release checklist; attach short postmortem if any incidents occurred.

Notes to self / loose ends:
- TODO: add a small synthetic test that exercises kvcache under partial-load; current test suite misses this pattern (REL-2345).
- Check if the BOM for traffic-router has the backoff fix (PR #1130) — I think it's merged but verify before full 100%.
- Consider adding a temporary sampling rule to capture full request traces for the 50% stage (to avoid overwhelming tracing backend).
- Slack reaction shorthand: `:rocket:` for green at 20%, `:eyes:` for paused/escalate.

Quick commands cheat sheet (copyable):
- Promote canary -> `curl -XPOST $RELEASE_API/promote -d '{"percent": 20}'`
- Snapshot dashboard -> `grafana snapshot dashboard/3505`
- Mute alert -> `amtool mute add --selector="alertname=high-error" --duration=2h`

Appendix: links and references: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1123, design: confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/Delta+Rollout+Design, tickets: REL-2345 (kvcache test), REL-2346 (rollback incident template).

If anything unexpected: pause the ramp, collect logs for 10m, escalate to Release Lead. Keep comms short and explicit.

— Aisha

(End of draft)
